parent_objective: audit logging-only metric instrumentation implementation before rerun design
blocked_by: implementation must be audited before revised-semantics execution design
supersedes: direct revised-semantics execution immediately after instrumentation implementation

public_gates: M1747 must audit that M1746 is logging-only and test-covered
M1747 must decide whether to route to smoke execution design repair bounded-panel design or branch synthesis
M1747 must not run full rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles rank controller families or claim paper-level evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run full environment rollout

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits logging-only metric instrumentation before execution design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: implementation audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1746 changed actor observation reward or termination behavior
stop if focused tests do not cover every metric family
stop if audit admits execution without smoke design
stop if audit ranks controller-family profiles
fallback_plan: route to implementation repair if guardrails or tests fail
route to bounded-panel design if instrumentation is too broad for a safe rerun
route to scenario execution design if audit passes

admission_evidence: M1746 implements metric helpers and focused tests for the M1745 definitions
blocked_shortcuts: do not change reward or termination behavior
do not claim paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
allowed_updates: M1747 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up execution-design or repair manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; instrumentation audit cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit may preserve profile controls but must not interpret metric logging as self-ID evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If instrumentation audit fails, record implementation limitation rather than self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1746 can be audited as logging-only, test-covered outcome metric instrumentation and routed safely before revised execution.
success_criteria: M1746 logging-only contract and focused tests are audited
next route is execution design repair bounded-panel design branch synthesis or stop
full rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes ranking and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit omits logging-only contract or test evidence
audit admits rollout without execution design
full rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion actor-input reward or termination changes occur
paper-level or level3 claims are made

commands.name: audit
commands.command: write outcome metric instrumentation result audit

decision_rule: M1747 passes if it audits M1746 as logging-only and chooses a route without admitting execution prematurely.
